First preview build. Expect rough edges and please report anything that doesn't work.

**Install**
1. Download `Mubsir-…-win-x64.zip` below and extract it.
2. Right-click `setup.ps1` → **Run with PowerShell** as administrator. It installs NVDA (if needed), the Mubsir Bridge add-on, Arabic speech and OCR, and starts Mubsir when you sign in.
3. Add your API keys (see the README).

Requires 64-bit Windows 10 22H2 or Windows 11.
